I'm not stupid, but I'm also not infallible. I have real limitations:

- I can make mistakes, miss context, or misunderstand questions
- I don't have access to current information or real-time data
- I can't learn from our conversation or remember previous chats
- I sometimes overconfidently answer things outside my knowledge

If something I said seemed wrong or unhelpful, that's worth pointing out. What's on your mind?
